facts.fact: 邀请信的对象是伦敦女性
邀请发出于 1990 年代末、世纪末
facts.anchor: It was nearly the end of the nineties and the end of a century.

facts.fact: 邀请提到荷兰老年女性住在自己运营的居住群体，各有私人住宅、共享聚会空间
facts.anchor: in residential groups they run themselves, where they have their own private homes but share space where they meet as a group

facts.fact: 第一人称作者正在研究这场运动，并邀人参加工作坊
facts.anchor: Let me know if you would like to come to a workshop I am running on my research into this movement.

facts.fact: 回应者聚在 King's Cross 一家不起眼酒吧的角落
facts.anchor: Just a group of older women in the corner of an innocuous-looking pub somewhere in King’s Cross.

facts.fact: 作者称这些女性是未来的先驱
facts.anchor: But these women were future pioneers.

facts.fact: 作者把她们的事业称为「ageing powerfully together」的开创性工作
facts.anchor: in their groundbreaking work on ageing powerfully together
